sources.title: GitHub - Martysunshine/Quran-verse-finder: AI-Powered Quran Verse ...
sources.snippet: AI-powered semantic search for Quran verses. Given a 10+ word description, this app suggests 3-5 relevant Quran passages using local Sentence-Transformers embeddings and an optional Cross-Encoder reranker. No paid APIs.
